meta.title: Reference · Aethyr docs
meta.description: Every tool Aethyr ships, grouped by category, plus configuration and backends.

sections.heading: Tools by category
sections.html:
Every tool Aethyr ships, grouped by category.

Read tools can't mutate. Native write tools compile before they save, batches roll back on a compile error, and the first save of each asset per session is backed up. Bridged epic_* writes and run_python_script skip those safeguards, so read back what landed. tools/list starts with a small core set plus meta-tools, and your AI widens it with enable_tool_category or calls any tool directly with call_tool, so the catalog below is broader than the first listing a client sees.

tools.description: Execute a UE console command (e.g. stat unit, showflag.bones 1, r.ScreenPercentage 75).

tools.name: get_autosave_status

tools.name: get_blueprint_breakpoints

tools.name: get_curve_editor_selection

tools.name: get_cvar
tools.description: Read a console variable's current value.

tools.description: World Partition data layers + per-layer effective runtime state (Unloaded/Loaded/Activated).

tools.name: get_ddc_state

tools.name: get_debug_instance
tools.description: PIE-attached debug object for a Blueprint (UBlueprint::GetObjectBeingDebugged): {valid, has_debug_object, debug_object_name, debug_object_path}.

tools.name: get_details_panel_state
tools.description: The level editor's actor Details panel state: the selected-objects list, read through PropertyEditor's IDetailsView.

tools.name: get_editor_theme

tools.name: get_file_lock_status

tools.name: get_focused_widget
tools.description: Slate widget the user is currently typing into / focused on.

tools.name: get_focused_window
tools.description: What the user is looking at in the editor right now.

tools.name: get_foliage_paint_state
tools.description: Foliage Edit Mode paint state.

tools.name: get_game_feature_state
tools.description: Look up a single Game Feature Plugin's state by name (case-insensitive match against plugin_name).

tools.name: get_gizmo_state
tools.description: Translation gizmo state for the active level viewport.

tools.name: get_hidden_actors

tools.name: get_hidden_layers
tools.description: Names of editor layers whose visibility is off (ULayersSubsystem).

tools.name: get_hover_target
tools.description: Hit-proxy target at a pixel in the active level viewport.

tools.name: get_isolate_mode
tools.description: Show-only-selected / isolate mode state (UE 5.6+).

tools.name: get_landscape_paint_state
tools.description: Landscape Edit Mode paint state: brush radius, paint brush radius, tool strength, paint tool strength, and the target-layers name filter.

tools.name: get_lighting_build_progress
tools.description: Static lighting build state via UEditorEngine::IsLightingBuildCurrentlyRunning/IsLightingBuildCurrentlyExporting.

tools.name: get_live_coding_state

tools.name: get_material_editor_state
tools.description: Material editor selection state.

tools.name: get_material_instance_params
tools.description: Dump scalar/vector/texture parameter values from a UMaterialInstanceConstant asset.

tools.name: get_mesh_paint_state
tools.description: Mesh Paint mode state for the vertex color/weight sub-modes: active tool name, brush size/strength.

tools.name: get_mesh_preview_state
tools.description: Static mesh editor preview state: forced LOD level and currently-displayed LOD index.

tools.name: get_modal_state
tools.description: Is a modal Slate window blocking input right now?

tools.name: get_modeling_state
tools.description: Modeling Tools Editor Mode state: active tool name, and brush size/strength when the active tool's property set derives from UBrushBaseProperties.

tools.name: get_monitor_info

tools.name: get_niagara_module_selection

tools.name: get_outliner_state
tools.description: World Outliner UI state: active filter count, column list, and the search-highlight text (a proxy for the live search string), read through the SceneOutliner module's public ISceneOutliner interface.

tools.name: get_pending_changelist
tools.description: The provider's default/pending changelist, via GetChangelists(ForceUpdate) (see list_changelists).

tools.name: get_pie_state
tools.description: Is Play-In-Editor running right now?

tools.name: get_pinned_actors
tools.description: Actors pinned in the World Outliner (World Partition pinning), found by asking UWorldPartition:.

tools.name: get_plugin_dependencies

tools.name: get_plugin_descriptor
tools.description: Read the full .uplugin descriptor for plugin_name.

tools.name: get_project_setting_values
tools.description: All property values of one settings section (UDeveloperSettings CDO), each {name, value, type} where value is the reflection-exported text.

tools.name: get_recently_opened_assets
tools.description: Recently-opened assets from the editor MRU list, most-recent first (package paths).

tools.name: get_recently_saved_packages

tools.name: get_recovery_state

tools.name: get_render_queue

tools.name: get_selected_folders
tools.description: Currently-selected folder paths in the Content Browser tree (distinct from assets: folders are navigation rows).

tools.name: get_shader_compile_state
tools.description: Shader-compilation backlog via GShaderCompilingManager: {is_compiling, outstanding_jobs, pending_jobs}.

tools.name: get_show_flags
tools.description: Read the active level viewport's commonly-toggled show flags.

tools.name: get_snapping_settings
tools.description: Editor snapping settings: grid + rotation snap toggles, current grid sizes (position + rotation), vertex snapping, snap-to-actor distance.

tools.name: get_source_control_provider
tools.description: Active source-control provider: {name, enabled, available}.

tools.name: get_source_control_status
tools.description: Per-file source-control status: {valid, controlled, checked_out, checked_out_other, modified, current}.

tools.name: get_static_mesh_info
tools.description: Static mesh LOD / triangle / vertex info.

tools.name: get_status_bar_messages
tools.description: The level editor status bar's current message text, read back from each live.

tools.name: get_streaming_sources
tools.description: World Partition streaming sources (camera/player providers driving cell streaming).

tools.name: get_take_recorder_state
tools.description: Take Recorder state: whether a recording is currently active (is_recording), and, while recording.

tools.name: get_texture_paint_state
tools.description: Mesh Paint mode state for the texture color/asset sub-modes: active tool name, brush size/strength.

tools.name: get_trace_state
tools.description: Unreal Insights trace connection state via FTraceAuxiliary (Core): connected, paused, connection_type (network|file|none), destination (host or file path).

tools.name: get_umg_editor_state
tools.description: Selection state for a UMG Widget Blueprint editor.

tools.name: get_view_mode

tools.name: get_viewport_camera_settings

tools.name: get_viewport_realtime

tools.name: get_visible_actors
tools.description: Actors visible in the active level viewport: frustum-tested against the camera, filtered by class substring (class_filter, case-sensitive) and max distance (max_distance in cm; 0 = no limit).

tools.name: get_watched_pins

tools.name: get_workspace_layout

tools.name: goto_camera_bookmark

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Probe whether the live editor is responsive.

tools.name: list_actor_abilities

tools.name: list_automation_tests
tools.description: Registered automation tests (FAutomationTestFramework, synchronous).

tools.name: list_changelists

tools.name: list_game_features

tools.name: list_loaded_levels

tools.name: list_loaded_partition_cells
tools.description: Loaded World Partition runtime cells for the current world (name, level_package, state: "loaded" or "activated", is_always_loaded, data_layers).

tools.name: list_plugins

tools.description: All Project/Editor Settings sections (UDeveloperSettings CDOs): each {container, category, section, class_path}.

tools.name: live_coding_compile

tools.name: open_asset_editor

tools.description: Read recent entries from the editor's output log.

tools.name: reset_project_setting

tools.name: set_active_cook_target

tools.name: set_actor_visibility
tools.description: Show or hide an actor in the editor viewport by name via SetIsTemporarilyHiddenInEditor (does not dirty the package).

tools.name: set_cvar
tools.description: Set a UE console variable (e.g. r.ScreenPercentage).

tools.name: set_gizmo_mode
tools.description: Set the transform gizmo mode in the active level viewport: translate, rotate, or scale (case-insensitive).

tools.name: set_layer_visibility
tools.description: Show or hide an editor layer by name (ULayersSubsystem).

tools.name: set_plugin_enabled
tools.description: Enable or disable a plugin in the project's .uproject descriptor (IProjectManager).

tools.name: set_project_setting
tools.description: Set one property on a settings section by class_path + property name, importing value from text, then persisting to the class's Default*.ini.

tools.name: set_selection
tools.description: Replace (or extend) the editor viewport's actor selection.

tools.name: set_show_flag
tools.description: Toggle a viewport show flag (Bones, Bounds, Collision, Wireframe, Lighting).

tools.name: set_view_mode
tools.description: Set the active level viewport's view mode.

tools.name: set_viewport_realtime
tools.description: Enable or disable realtime rendering in the active level viewport.

tools.name: spawn_actor
tools.description: Spawn an actor of the given UClass in the current level.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a high-res screenshot to disk.

tools.name: ui_focus_tab
tools.description: Focus (foreground) an editor dock tab by a substring of its label.

tools.name: ui_invoke_menu
tools.description: Execute an editor menu command by its registered UToolMenus menu name + entry: the most geometry-independent way to drive the editor (no clicking, no painted geometry, the menu need not be open).

tools.name: add_component
tools.description: Add a component (StaticMeshComponent, AudioComponent, etc.) to a Blueprint's SimpleConstructionScript tree: author-time component setup, not runtime spawning.

tools.name: add_function
tools.description: Create a new BP function graph with the given name.

tools.name: add_function_input
tools.description: Add an input parameter to an existing function.

tools.name: add_function_output

tools.name: add_node

tools.name: add_struct_member

tools.description: Add a member variable to a Blueprint class.

tools.description: Execute a batch of write operations sequentially in a single tool call.

tools.name: attach_component

tools.description: Auto-position the nodes in a Blueprint graph so they don't overlap.

tools.name: bp_structural_diff
tools.description: Compare two Blueprints structurally: variables, components, function/macro/event-graph node signatures, connection counts.

tools.name: clone_graph

tools.name: create_blueprint
tools.description: Create a new Blueprint asset under /Game/...

tools.description: Create a new User Defined Enum (UUserDefinedEnum) under /Game/...

tools.name: create_struct

tools.name: delete_node

tools.name: delete_variable

tools.name: find_dangling_references
tools.description: Walk a Blueprint's function bodies (and optionally top-level graphs) for nodes referencing variables / intra-BP functions that no longer exist on the BP.

tools.description: Search all nodes in a Blueprint by class name or title substring (case-insensitive): searches ALL graphs at once, unlike get_graph which reads one named graph.

tools.description: Find Blueprints under path that match a structural query: extend parent_class, override function_name, and/or implement interface.

tools.description: List the SCS components (StaticMeshComponent, LightComponent, child actors, etc.) attached to a blueprint, with parent/child hierarchy.

tools.name: get_function

tools.name: get_graph

tools.name: get_node
tools.description: Fetch a single K2 node by GUID inside a graph.

tools.description: Add interface to the implemented-interfaces list of the asset Blueprint, generating the stub function graphs the interface requires.

tools.name: list_blueprints
tools.description: List Blueprint assets under a content path.

tools.name: list_timelines
tools.description: List all Timeline nodes in a Blueprint (names, track counts, length, loop, auto_play).

tools.name: list_variables
tools.description: List all member variables on a Blueprint, with type, default, category, and replication state.

tools.name: peek_graph

tools.name: read_blueprint

tools.name: read_timeline
tools.description: Read a Timeline from a Blueprint: float/vector/event/linear_color tracks with their FRichCurveKey arrays (time, value, interp).

tools.name: remove_component
tools.description: Remove a component from a Blueprint's SCS tree by name.

tools.name: rename_variable

tools.name: set_pin_default
tools.description: Set the literal default value on a node's input pin.

tools.name: set_variable_category
tools.description: Change the My-Blueprint-panel category label on a Blueprint member variable (the "Stats" / "Combat" group header in the BP editor).

tools.name: set_variable_default
tools.description: Change a Blueprint member variable's default value (string form, as displayed in the Details panel: e.g. "100.0" for a float, "true"/"false" for a bool).

tools.name: summarize_blueprint

tools.name: wire_pins
tools.description: Connect two K2 pins.

tools.description: Add a USoundNode subclass (e.g. SoundNodeMixer, SoundNodeRandom, SoundNodeLooping, SoundNodeModulator, SoundNodeWavePlayer, any concrete engine USoundNode class) to a USoundCue's runtime node tree...

tools.name: connect_sound_nodes
tools.description: Wire a SoundCue node (added via add_sound_node) into the runtime tree.

tools.name: create_metasound
tools.description: Create a new MetaSound asset under /Game/...: a UMetaSoundSource (default) or UMetaSoundPatch (kind:"patch").

tools.description: Create a new USoundAttenuation asset under /Game/...

tools.name: create_sound_class
tools.description: Create a new USoundClass asset under /Game/...

tools.name: create_sound_concurrency
tools.description: Create a new USoundConcurrency asset under /Game/...

tools.name: create_sound_cue
tools.description: Create a new USoundCue asset under /Game/...

tools.name: list_metasound_node_classes
tools.description: Discovery companion to add_metasound_node (the list_node_kinds analogue for MetaSound).

tools.name: list_metasounds
tools.description: List all UMetaSoundSource / UMetaSoundPatch assets under a content path.

tools.name: list_sound_classes
tools.description: List all USoundClass assets under a content path.

tools.name: list_sound_cues
tools.description: List all USoundCue assets under a content path.

tools.name: list_sound_waves

sections.heading: Skills & the audit agent
sections.html: These ship with the plugin under AI/. AethyrMcp.exe setup installs them for the AI clients you use: skills to ~/.agents/skills/ (Copilot CLI, VS Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Windsurf) and ~/.claude/skills/ (Claude Code), and the agent to ~/.claude/agents/, ~/.copilot/agents/ or ~/.gemini/agents/. --no-skills skips them.

skills.name: aethyr-bp-audit
skills.description: A read-only auditor. Ask it "audit /Game/AI" and it fans out reads and returns a tight report without touching anything.

sections.heading: Configuration
sections.html: Most of these are optional. Set them in your MCP client's env block.

flags.name: AETHYR_PROJECT
flags.description: Path to the .uproject to drive. If unset, the server uses the .uproject in the folder your client was opened in, or a parent folder. With none there, it starts without a project and says so. Setup pins it for VS Code and Cursor. Set it by hand for Claude Desktop and Windsurf.

flags.name: AETHYR_READ_ONLY
flags.description: Set 1 for a read-only session: Aethyr's typed write tools and bridged Epic writes refuse before touching a file. Every build allows writes by default, the Fab build included since 0.5.1.

flags.name: AETHYR_ALLOW_WRITE
flags.description: 1 by default in every build. Set 0 for a read-only session. An explicit AETHYR_READ_ONLY wins if both are set.

flags.name: AETHYR_RO_ALLOW_CONSOLE
flags.description: 0 by default. In a read-only session console_command is refused, because a console command can change assets. Set 1 to allow it for console diagnostics.

flags.name: AETHYR_ENGINE_DIR
flags.description: Engine root. Found automatically from the .uproject's EngineAssociation, a source-build registry entry, or the Launcher's install list. Set it only if discovery fails.

flags.name: AETHYR_ENGINE_SCAN
flags.description: 1 by default. As a last step, Aethyr looks at every engine installed on the machine and picks the one that matches your project's compiled binaries. Set 0 to skip that step.

flags.name: AETHYR_ENGINE_SCAN_DIRS
flags.description: Extra folders for that scan, separated by semicolons, one level deep. For an engine installed outside the registry and the Launcher's list.

flags.name: AETHYR_BACKEND
flags.description: auto when a project is found (the default). With no project the server starts with no backend, and every tool call says to open your client in the project folder or set AETHYR_PROJECT. Other values are live, commandlet and mock. An explicit mock serves fixtures with no project.

flags.name: AETHYR_BACKUP
flags.description: 1 by default: copies an asset to a backup ring (the newest 5 copies) before its first save each session. Set 0 to turn backups off.

flags.name: AETHYR_AUTO_CHECKOUT
flags.description: 1 by default: auto-checks-out an asset from source control before a write.

flags.name: AETHYR_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
flags.description: Per-call subprocess timeout (default 120).

flags.name: AETHYR_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
flags.description: How long to wait for the headless editor's first ready signal. Default 600. A big project with a cold cache can take 5 to 10 minutes the first time.

flags.name: AETHYR_DAEMON
flags.description: 1 by default. Set 0 to fall back to a one-shot editor launch per call.

flags.name: AETHYR_DAEMON_IDLE_SECONDS
flags.description: Default 300. The headless editor exits after this many seconds with no connected clients. The minimum is 5.

flags.name: AETHYR_DAEMON_MAX_LIFETIME_SECONDS
flags.description: Default 3600. The headless editor exits after this long no matter what. Set 0 to turn the limit off.

flags.name: AETHYR_PREWARM
flags.description: 0 by default. Set 1 to start the headless editor when the server starts, so the first call doesn't pay the cold start.

flags.name: AETHYR_EDITOR_ARGS
flags.description: Extra arguments added to the headless editor's command line, separated by spaces. Avoid -EnableAllPlugins.

flags.name: AETHYR_EDITOR_CONFIG
flags.description: Picks which UnrealEditor-Cmd build to run: Development, DebugGame or Debug. Unset, Aethyr picks the configuration whose project manifest BuildId matches the engine and whose Aethyr module is built, and prefers Development when more than one matches. doctor and health_check show the choice, where it came from and the manifest checked. Set it only to force a configuration, and then it always wins.

flags.name: AETHYR_EDITOR_TARGET
flags.description: Editor target name for projects with a unique build environment. Aethyr looks for <Project>/Binaries/Win64/<Target>-Cmd.exe before the engine's own UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe.

flags.name: AETHYR_EDITOR_CMD
flags.description: Full path to a -Cmd.exe that overrides both of the above.

flags.name: AETHYR_PLUGIN_DENYLIST
flags.description: Comma-separated plugin names to skip when the headless editor starts, for a plugin that crashes on load. Also read from Config/DefaultAethyr.ini under [Aethyr] as PluginDenylist=, and the two are combined.

flags.name: AETHYR_PLUGIN_AUTO_QUARANTINE
flags.description: 1 by default. Plugins that are predicted to be broken, or that break the headless editor's startup twice, are set aside along with the plugins that depend on them. Set 0 to report failures without quarantining.

flags.name: AETHYR_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
flags.description: Default 30. How long the server remembers read-tool answers. A write clears the entries for the asset it touched. Set 0 to turn the cache off.

flags.name: AETHYR_LIST_MAX_BYTES
flags.description: Default 16384. The size budget for one list reply. A page that would go over is cut short, and next_cursor continues from there. Set 0 to turn the budget off.

flags.name: AETHYR_LIVE_PORT
flags.description: TCP port for the live backend. By default the editor picks a free port and publishes it in <Project>/Saved/aethyr-live.json, and the server reads it from there. Set it in both processes only if you need a fixed port.

flags.name: AETHYR_LIVE_TOKEN
flags.description: Shared secret for the live backend. By default the editor makes a random one and writes it to the same file. Set it only if you'd rather use an env var, for example in CI.

flags.name: AETHYR_LIVE_DISABLED
flags.description: 0 by default. Set 1 so the editor doesn't start its TCP listener, for a daemon-only setup.

flags.name: AETHYR_ALLOW_PYTHON
flags.description: Read in the editor's environment. run_python_script runs by default. Set 0 to turn it off. It still runs in a read-only session.

flags.name: AETHYR_ALLOW_UI
flags.description: Read in the editor's environment. ui_focus_tab and ui_invoke_menu run by default. Set 0 to turn them off. ui_invoke_menu is refused in a read-only session.

flags.name: AETHYR_HTTP_PORT
flags.description: Unset by default, so the server uses stdio. Set a port from 1 to 65535 to serve JSON-RPC over a localhost HTTP socket instead.

flags.name: AETHYR_HTTP_TOKEN
flags.description: Bearer token for the HTTP transport. If you leave it unset, the server makes a random one at startup and prints it once to stderr.

flags.name: AETHYR_EPIC_INTEROP
flags.description: 1 by default. Set 0 to turn the Engine Toolset Bridge off, so the epic_* tools are never offered.

flags.name: AETHYR_EPIC_URL
flags.description: Full loopback URL for Epic's MCP server, for example http://127.0.0.1:8123/mcp. By default Aethyr reads the port and path from your project's settings and falls back to 127.0.0.1:8000/mcp. A non-loopback host is ignored.

flags.name: AETHYR_EPIC_AUTOSTART
flags.description: 1 by default, read by the editor module. Set 0 in the editor's environment to stop it starting Epic's MCP server on load.

flags.name: AETHYR_EPIC_PRIVATE_DIR
flags.description: Where launch-editor --private-epic-build keeps its private copies of Epic's plugins. The default is <Project>/Saved/Aethyr/EpicMcp. A folder inside the engine is refused.

flags.name: AETHYR_EPIC_BACKUP
flags.description: Copies the target .uasset to Saved/AethyrBackups/epic-* before a bridged write. On by default in the Fab build and off in the full build. A bridged write never gets Aethyr's own compile gate or atomic rollback.

flags.name: AETHYR_HUB
flags.description: On by default, so every client on a project shares one server. Set 0 for one server per client.

flags.name: AETHYR_HUB_IDLE_SECONDS
flags.description: Default 600. How long the shared server keeps running with no attached clients.

flags.name: AETHYR_HUB_BUSY_WAIT_MS
flags.description: Default 5000. How long a client's call waits for the shared backend to free up before it gets a retryable busy error.

flags.name: AETHYR_UPDATE_CHECK
flags.description: 1 by default. Controls the once-a-day release check and the "update available" notice at connect. Set 0 to turn both off. The Fab build has no update check.

flags.name: AETHYR_UPDATE_REPO
flags.description: Where the update check and apply_update look for releases, as owner/repo. For a private mirror.

backends.name: auto
backends.description: The default. Probes each call and routes to live if an editor is open, else commandlet.

backends.name: live
backends.description: Talks to a running editor over a local TCP socket (fast; great while you're working in-editor).

backends.name: commandlet
backends.description: Spawns a headless editor to serve calls when none is open.

backends.name: mock
backends.description: Fixtures only, no engine; for trying the wire format without a project. Writes are blocked.

sections.heading: Command line
sections.html:
Run AethyrMcp.exe with one of these. With no arguments it runs the MCP server on stdio.

  • setup --project <dir or .uproject>: install or update Aethyr in one project and register it with your AI clients. See install.md. --dry-run previews the plan.
  • launch-editor --project <dir or .uproject>: start the editor with Epic's MCP on for one session.
  • doctor: run setup checks. It exits 0 when everything is healthy.
  • config --client=<name>: print a ready-to-paste config snippet for a client, with your paths filled in.
  • dump-tools [--md|--json]: print the full tool catalog, offline.
  • call <tool> --args '<json>': run one tool and print the result.
  • --version: print the build version.

Engine Toolset Bridge

The three epic_* tools (epic_list_toolsets, epic_describe_toolset and epic_call_tool) reach Epic's own toolsets in a running UE 5.8 editor. Aethyr's plugin pulls Epic's MCP plugin in for the editor and starts its server. A Blueprint-only project on the precompiled zip uses Saved/Aethyr/Launch-Editor.bat instead. Set AETHYR_EPIC_INTEROP=0 to turn the bridge off.
